acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Each marble has a complete texture set in /public/textures/{slug}/ - diffuse.jpg - base color/pattern at 2K resolution (2048×2048px) minimum - normal.jpg - surface detail for 3D lighting (2K resolution) - roughness.jpg - finish variation map (2K resolution) - All textures are seamlessly tileable for 3D mapping

Each marble has optimized preview images - preview.jpg - 400×400px square thumbnail for gallery cards - hero.jpg - 1200×800px landscape for marble detail pages - Images are properly compressed (JPEG quality 80-85)

Texture folder structure matches seeded marble slugs: - /public/textures/carrara-white/ - /public/textures/nero-marquina/ - /public/textures/calacatta-gold/ - /public/textures/emperador-dark/ - /public/textures/statuario/ - /public/textures/verde-guatemala/ - /public/textures/rosa-portogallo/ - /public/textures/sahara-noir/ - /public/textures/bianco-sivec/ - /public/textures/travertino-romano/

Images load correctly via next/image with optimization - Test page verifies all textures load without 404 errors - Images render at appropriate sizes for their use case - WebP conversion happens automatically via Next.js

Total texture budget respects ~60MB limit - All 10 marbles × 5 images per marble = 50 files total - Estimated size: ~6MB per marble (3×2K textures + 2 preview images) - Verify total /public/textures/ directory size
Texture utility functions created for programmatic access - Helper function to get texture paths by marble slug - Type-safe texture path constants - Fallback handling for missing textures
